news.title: Stock Futures Tumble on Report of Iran Attack on US Warship
news.summary: Stocks were to drop on Monday after Iranian state media said missiles had hit a U.S. warship in the Strait of Hormuz, stoking fears that the war in the Middle East could escalate again.  S&P 500 futures fell 0.4% and contracts tied to the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 were 0.5% lower.  The S&P and the Nasdaq closed at records on Friday, powered higher by a surge in software stocks.
